title: GEN NX API Settings (official Korean page)
notes: Verified connection procedure for GEN NX: [Apps] → [API] → [API Settings]; copy Base URL and MAPI-Key after Connect; status must be Connected. This page does not provide NODE/ELEM/UNIT field tables. Never hard-code or store a real MAPI-Key in the skill package.

title: How NX Open API is routed (official CIVIL NX article; Japanese title also names GEN NX)
